newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry.
There were 20,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 17,000 formulated and 1,100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 10 loads or 400 head of CME cattle.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - 40,000 Year Ago - 3,400
Wk to Date - 20,400 Week Ago - 64,300 Year Ago - 124,100
